plan.scope: Existing 16 survey runs and all 12 assigned slots of the closed cadence batch; no simulation, tuning or release
plan.decision: Determine whether a plausible late-contact opportunity remains; actual causal response stays unknown without a counterfactual
plan.sampling: Reuse original GT-header slip, joint support, native replay and 98% coverage unchanged. Actual trajectory diagnostics use original source stamps and backward-only reference lookup.
plan.timing_origin: Each run's first saved obstacle manifold; also retain first loaded contact for every component
plan.remaining_cost: Slip integral remaining until tc+3, divided by total tc..tc+3. IMU: unfiltered squared-sample sum remaining, not energy or a time integral; export native sample RMS/peak separately. These are observed contributions, not preventable fractions.
plan.pair_diagnostics: All eight survey pairs and all four assigned cadence 20ms-vs-100ms pairs. Source-stamp candidate minus backward-only reference, subtract precontact median difference (-0.3..-0.05s); no causal interpretation.
plan.divergence_rule: First sustained negative baseline-adjusted difference for >=60ms, source gaps <=40.001ms body /10.001ms wheel. Search -0.3..1s, retain any pre-command crossing and its source support. Report bracket and confirmation, no interpolated onset. Sensitivities are diagnostics, not application thresholds.
plan.clean_floor_comparison: Historical 239..254ms body90 response from first ramp input is a scenario-transfer illustration only; includes ramp already, not a measured contact-response bound.
plan.missing: Keep failed/unrun slots; no quality comparison on an integrity-failed cadence batch; valid timing pairs are descriptive only
plan.stop: One offline analysis and targeted helper tests, ending in a written decision; no repeated audit of unchanged evidence
